definition.name: Sports Court Booking
definition.overview:
A **Sports Court Booking** application is the player-side application for finding and reserving time on sports courts and facilities — tennis, padel, pickleball, badminton, squash, football pitches, and similar — at venues the player does not own or operate. The player searches for a venue, sees which courts are free at which times, reserves a slot alone or with a party (or takes a spot in a shared game), pays for the booking, and manages it — reschedule, cancel, review history — up to the moment of play.

The defining core is small:

```text
Player-facing bookable court-time inventory
└── Court reservation (the player's booking of record)
    └── Mediated third-party venue relationship
        (venue's prices and policies govern; platform mediates
         discovery → booking → payment → arrival)
```

Everything else commonly associated with these products — open matches and player-matching communities, skill levels and ratings, loyalty points, chat, waiting lists, coaching discovery — is widespread in current products but is not part of the defining core. A regional single-sport booking portal with real-time availability and self-service cancellation satisfies the same structure without any of those extras.

The boundary that matters most: this is the **demand side** of court-time booking. The venue is a third party whose prices, cancellation policies, and access rules govern the booking. When the center shifts to the venue operator's own system of record — court inventory of record, member governance, programming, revenue accumulation — the product is a different Application Type (Racquet Club Management, Sports Facility Management).

```text
面向玩家的可预订场地时间库存
└── 场地预订（玩家的预订记录）
    └── 调解的第三方场所关系
        （场所的价格和政策主导；平台调解

```

Three structures. If any one is removed, the product is no longer recognizable as sports court booking:

- **Player-facing bookable court-time inventory** — sports venues held with their courts and bookable time slots, surfaced for player discovery and searchable by location, sport, and time, with availability kept current (real-time where the venue's calendar is integrated; an enquiry channel where it is not). This is the supply side as the player sees it. Without it, the product is a venue directory — or an operator's calendar that players cannot see.
- **Court reservation** — a specific court held for a specific slot by a player, who may organize a party (friends added to the booking, often each paying a share) or take a spot in a shared game. The reservation persists in the player's own record — upcoming and past bookings — and is self-managed: rescheduled or cancelled under the venue's rules, through to the played slot. Without it, the inventory is a listing with nothing to book.
- **Mediated third-party venue relationship** — the venue is not the player's organization. Its prices, cancellation policy, and access rules govern the booking; the platform mediates the loop from discovery to booking to payment to arrival, and per-booking settlement is the dominant completion — in-app payment (full or split among players), a platform wallet, or pay-at-venue arrangements. Without this posture, the product is the venue's own booking channel — the operator's system, not the player's.

definition.rules:
### The venue's rules govern; the platform enforces

Prices, slot durations, cancellation windows, and access restrictions are set by each venue. The platform displays them at booking time, enforces them in the app (cancellation is simply not offered outside the window), and directs the player to contact the venue for exceptions — weather calls, late changes, oversized groups. The platform is a mediator, not the rule-maker.

### A held slot removes capacity

The reservation is a real commitment against the venue's calendar: once confirmed, the slot is no longer bookable by other players. Cancellations and no-shows are visible states; venues counter them with cancellation cutoffs, no-refund policies inside the window, and (in some products) automatic cancellation of unfilled open games.

### Payment is per booking, and split payment is native

The dominant settlement is payment at booking time, in full or split among the players — each co-player pays a share of the same reservation. Platform service or convenience fees may sit on top and are commonly non-refundable even when the slot price is refunded. Pay-at-venue arrangements exist; where they do, platforms can treat them as offline bookings outside the tracked record.

### Open games aggregate before they commit

In community-driven products, a spot in an open game is not yet a court reservation: the court is reserved once enough players have joined, and if the game does not fill in time it is cancelled automatically with refunds to the players. The individual booker is not responsible for filling a game they joined.

### Private-club access is mediated, not granted

Where a venue is a private club, booking its courts may require club membership. The platform mediates the relationship — in some products a membership request can be sent from the player's account — but membership itself is the club's to grant. The demand-side product carries the channel; the operator side carries the governance.

### The player's record is the memory

Upcoming and past bookings persist in the player's account — this is what makes the loop repeatable: favorites, history, receipts, and (where present) match results and ratings accumulate around the same identity.

definition.name: Sports Facility Management
definition.name_zh: 体育场馆管理软件（Sports Facility Management）
definition.overview:
A **Sports Facility Management** application is the operator-side business system of record for running a sports facility — a multisport complex, ice arena, turf/field house, court facility, batting-cage center, or similar venue — as a business.

Its defining core is small:

```text
The facility's rentable-space inventory of record
└── Bookings (a party holds a specific space for a specific time)
    └── The facility's money record (charges raised, settled, accumulated)
```

Everything else commonly associated with these products — online self-service booking, leagues and camps, memberships and passes, point of sale, marketing, check-in hardware — is widespread in current products but is not what makes the product a sports facility management system. A booking-centric product with none of those additions, and a paper-era arena with a rental ledger and a wall calendar, both sit inside the Type.

When the center of gravity shifts to the player booking a venue as a third party, the product is a different Application Type (Sports Court Booking). When it shifts to membership and entry as the core relationship, it drifts toward Recreation Center Management. When it shifts to administering competition between organizations, it drifts toward League Management Platform.
definition.overview_zh:
一个**体育设施管理**应用程序是运营方的业务系统，用于管理体育设施——如综合运动中心、冰场、草皮/场地馆、球场设施、击球笼中心或类似场馆——的日常运营。

其定义性核心很小：

```text
设施的可租赁空间库存记录
└── 预订（一方为特定时间占用特定空间）
    └── 设施的资金记录（产生的费用、结算、累积）
```

其他通常与这些产品相关的功能——在线自助预订、联赛和训练营、会员和通行证、销售点、营销、签到硬件——在当前产品中很普遍，但并非使该产品成为体育设施管理系统的原因。一个没有这些附加功能的预订中心型产品，以及一个仅有租赁台账和墙上日历的纸时代竞技场，都属于该类型。

当重心转移到玩家作为第三方预订场地时，该产品是另一种应用程序类型（Sports Court Booking）。当重心转移到会员和入场作为核心关系时，它倾向于休闲中心管理。当重心转移到管理组织间竞争时，它倾向于联赛管理平台。
definition.dc:
**1. The facility's rentable-space inventory of record.**
The venue's spaces — courts, ice sheets, fields, turf, cages, lanes, rooms, simulators — are held as individually identified, bookable units. Each space carries operator-configured bookable time: when it can be reserved, in what increments, with what buffers between uses. Spaces are commonly grouped into types (all courts, all fields) that share settings, subdivided (a field split into halves for simultaneous practices), and organized across locations. Because many spaces share one calendar, the system prevents conflicts: booking one space can automatically block dependent spaces (renting the "entire facility" blocks every court and room in it).

**2. The booking as the unit of transaction.**
A booking is a party — a person, family, team, or organization — holding a specific space for a specific time. It is the atom of the whole system: rentals, parties, private lessons, league games, and camp sessions are all bookings (or booking-like events) placed against the inventory. A booking carries a lifecycle: requested → confirmed → paid → used → closed, with cancellation and refund paths. The facility keeps the record: who booked what, when, at what price, under what terms.

**3. The facility's money record.**
Charges are raised against bookings and usage. Pricing is structured by the nature of the space and the time: hourly or flat rates, different rates for different seasons, days, or peak windows, add-on fees (equipment, furniture, catering). Charges are settled — paid online, invoiced, or rung up at the desk — and accumulate into the facility's revenue and utilization record, which reporting turns into the operator's business picture (which surfaces and programs make money, where the open capacity is).

These three are jointly load-bearing. An inventory without bookings is a space list; bookings without an inventory are a widget over nothing; money without both is a payment terminal; inventory plus bookings without money is a shared calendar, not a business system.
definition.dc_zh:
1. **场馆的可租赁空间库存记录**：场馆内的各类空间（球场、冰场、草坪、人造草皮、笼式场地、赛道、房间、模拟器等）被作为独立识别、可预订的单元进行管理。每个空间都配有运营方设定的可预订时段：包括可预约的时间段、时间增量单位，以及使用间隔缓冲。空间通常按类型（所有球场、所有草坪）分组以共享设置，可细分（如将一个草坪分成两半供同时训练），并跨地点组织。由于多个空间共享一个日历，系统需防止冲突：预订一个空间可自动阻止关联空间（例如租用“整个场馆”会锁定其中的所有球场和房间）。

2. **预订作为事务的基本单元**：预订是一方（个人、家庭、团队或组织）对特定空间在特定时间的占用。它是整个系统运作的原子：租赁、聚会、私教课、联赛比赛和训练营课程都是基于库存的预订（或类似预订的事件）。预订具有完整生命周期：请求 → 确认 → 支付 → 使用 → 结束，并包含取消和退款流程。场馆保留完整记录：谁在何时预订了什么、价格如何、适用哪些条款。

3. **场馆的资金记录**：费用基于预订和使用情况产生。定价结构取决于空间性质与时间（按小时计费）。
definition.rules:
### Conflict prevention is structural

The inventory is shared: one space, many claimants. The system prevents double-booking automatically, and related-space rules extend this (booking a whole-facility block bars its parts; buffers keep turnaround time between uses). This is not a convenience feature — it is what makes a shared calendar into a capacity of record.

### Booking is not always instant

Self-service booking commonly supports a spectrum: instant paid booking, request-then-approval (the time is not held until staff confirm), request with hidden pricing, and login-required booking. The operator chooses per space or booking type. A confirmed request behaves like any other booking once approved.

### Pricing follows time

Charges are a function of the booking's shape: duration (hourly vs flat), season (date ranges with their own rates), day and time (peak/off-peak), and add-ons. Changing the time changes the price; the money record reflects the booking, not a menu price alone.

### Money is recorded, not just collected

Every charge — booking fee, program tuition, POS sale, refund — lands in the facility's revenue record against its category. Cancellations and refunds adjust the record rather than erasing history. Utilization and revenue reporting are two views of the same underlying bookings.

### Access is governed

Role-based permissions decide who can create, edit, or delete bookings and resources; customers book only what the operator has exposed; memberships or passes, where used, can gate what a customer may book or buy. Terms and conditions accepted at booking are retained with the record.

### The facility keeps its history

Bookings, programs, payments, and check-ins accumulate as the venue's operating record — searchable by date, space, party, and type — feeding permits, invoices, and reports after the fact.
definition.rules_zh:
### 冲突预防是结构性的

库存是共享的：一个空间，多个需求方。系统自动防止双重预订，相关空间规则扩展了这一点（预订整个设施区块会阻止其部分；缓冲时间保持使用间的周转时间）。这不是便利功能——它是使共享日历成为产能记录的关键。

### 预订并非总是即时的

自助预订通常支持一系列选项：即时付费预订、请求后批准（在工作人员确认前不保留时间）、请求隐藏定价，以及需要登录的预订。运营方为每个空间或预订类型选择。经批准的确认请求表现得像任何其他预订。

### 定价随时间而变

费用是预订形状的函数：时长（按小时或固定）、季节（具有各自费率的日期范围）、日期和时间（高峰/非高峰），以及附加项。改变时间会改变价格；资金记录反映预订，而不仅仅是菜单价格。

### 资金被记录，而不仅仅是收取

每笔费用——预订费、程序学费、POS销售、退款——都进入设施的收入记录中，对应其类别。取消和退款调整记录，而不是删除历史。利用率和收入报告是同一底层预订的两个视角。

### 访问受管理

基于角色的权限决定谁可以创建、编辑或删除预订和资源；客户只能预订运营方暴露的内容；会员或通行证（如果使用）可以限制客户可能预订或购买的内容。预订时接受的条款和条件随记录保留。

### 设施保留其历史

预订、程序、支付和签到累积为场馆的运营记录——可按日期、空间、方和类型搜索。

definition.name: Tee Time Booking Platform
aliases_zh: 球场开球时间预约系统
definition.overview:
A **Tee Time Booking Platform** is a golfer-facing application for finding and reserving tee times — the dated, time-stamped starting slots on golf courses from which a round of golf begins. The golfer searches courses, compares prices and availability, books a starting time for a party (or takes a spot in an organized game), pays, and manages the reservation up to arrival at the course.

The defining structure is small:

```text
Bookable tee-time inventory across golf courses
└── Tee time reservation (the golfer's booking of record:
    a named party holding a specific starting time)
    └── Mediated course relationship (course-set prices,
        policies and privileges; platform settles per booking)
```

Everything else commonly associated with these products — maps and destination browsing, prepaid deals, loyalty rewards, member tee-sheet visibility, mobile check-in, handicap verification, games and competitions, travel packages — is widespread in current products but is not part of the defining core. The platform is the demand side of golf commerce: the courses themselves remain independent businesses whose sheet of record, check-in desk, and revenue accounting live in their own systems (Golf Course Management). Remove the demand-side loop and what remains is a course directory; add the operator's system of record and you have crossed into the operator Type.
definition.overview_zh:
一款 **Tee Time 预订平台**是面向高尔夫球手的应用程序，用于查找和预订开球时间——即高尔夫球场上带有日期和时间戳的起始时段，一局高尔夫比赛从此开始。高尔夫球手搜索球场，比较价格和可用性，为团体预订起始时间（或在有组织的游戏中占位），支付并管理预订，直到到达球场。

其定义结构较小：

```text
可预订的开球时间库存，覆盖多个高尔夫球场
└── 开球时间预订（高尔夫球手的预订记录：
    持有特定起始时间的命名团体）
    └── 中介化的球场关系（球场设定价格、
        政策和特权；平台按预订结算）
```

其他通常与这些产品相关的功能——地图和目的地浏览、预付优惠、忠诚度奖励、会员开球时间表可见性、移动签到、差点验证、游戏和竞赛、旅行套餐——在现有产品中普遍存在，但并非定义核心的一部分。平台是高尔夫商业的需求侧：球场本身仍然是独立的业务，其记录表、签到台和收入会计都在自己的系统中（高尔夫球场管理系统）。移除需求侧循环，剩下的只是一个球场目录；添加运营者的记录系统，就跨入了运营者类型。
definition.dc:
Three structures, held together:

**1. Bookable tee-time inventory across golf courses.** The platform holds courses — with locations, hole layouts, photos, reviews, and from-prices — and, for each, the starting times a golfer can actually reserve. Inventory is surfaced for discovery: search by place or map, browse by region or destination, filter by holes format, price promotions, ratings, or facility features. Availability must be real enough to book from; a listing that cannot be booked from the golfer's side is a directory entry, not inventory.

**2. The tee time reservation as the golfer's booking of record.** When a golfer books, a reservation is created **in the golfer's own account**: course, date and starting time, hole format, number and identity of players, rate selections. It persists as the golfer's upcoming tee time (and later as history), it is the golfer's proof — a confirmation to the booker and the named players — and it is self-managed: the golfer can view, edit, cancel, or exit it, under the course's rules, through to the day of play. Per-player management is normal: a player can be added to a reservation, and a player can remove themselves from a reservation they did not create.

**3. The mediated third-party course relationship.** The courses on the platform are not the golfer's organization and are not governed by the platform. Their green fees, cancellation policies, membership privileges, and property rules are what actually govern the booking; the platform mediates the loop — discovery → booking → payment → confirmation → arrival — and enforces the course's rules on its behalf. Settlement is per booking and online-dominant: full payment at checkout for prepaid rates and deals, card-on-file payment at check-in where the course supports it, pay-at-course in some configurations. A platform booking fee may sit on top of the course's price without changing it.

The joint hold is load-bearing. Inventory without reservations is a listings site; reservations without browsable inventory are a bare widget; mediation without both is a review or discovery surface; and inventory plus reservations without the third-party relationship is simply the course's own booking channel — the operator's system, not this Type.
definition.dc_zh:
三个结构相互依存：

**1. 跨球场的可预订开球时间库存。** 平台整合球场信息——包括位置、球洞布局、照片、评论和起始价格——并为每个球场提供高尔夫球手可以实际预订的起始时间。库存信息以可发现的形式呈现：通过地点或地图搜索、按地区或目的地浏览、按球洞格式、价格促销、评分或设施特点筛选。信息必须真实到可以直接预订；如果用户端无法完成预订，则仅属于目录条目而非库存。

**2. 以开球时间预订作为球手的预订凭证。** 当球手预订时，系统会在其个人账户中创建预约记录：包含球场、日期和起始时间、球洞格式、球员人数与身份、价格选择。该记录持续作为球手未来的开球时间安排（及历史记录），是球手的凭证——为预订者及指定球员提供确认——并支持自主管理：球手可在球场规则允许范围内，至打球日当天查看、修改、取消或退出预约。支持按球员管理：球员可被加入预约，也可自行退出非本人创建的预约。

**3. 受中介约束的第三方球场关系。** 平台上的球场并非球手所属机构，亦不受平台管辖。其果岭费、取消政策
definition.rules:
### The course's rules govern; the platform enforces them

Cancellation, editing, and privilege rules belong to the course, not the platform. The recurring shape: self-service cancellation and edits are allowed only while the reservation is unpaid (or not under a prepaid term) and outside the course's advance cutoff; inside the cutoff, changes run through the course or the platform's support. Membership privileges — how far in advance a member may book, which times they may book, whom they may bring — are the course's member policy, mediated by the platform.

### Prepaid deals trade flexibility for price

Discounted online-only tee times are typically charged in full at booking and are non-refundable; their terms (cart inclusion, restrictions) are attached per deal, and bad-weather handling is its own mechanism (rain checks) rather than ordinary cancellation.

### Pricing is per player, and fees ride on top

Rates attach to each player (with member, guest, senior and similar classifications where the course uses them); carts and extras attach per player unless stated; a platform booking fee may be added without altering the course's price.

### A reservation is a party of named players

Players are named on the booking, receive confirmations individually, can be added before play, and can remove themselves subject to the same cutoff rules — the reservation is shared property of the party, anchored by the booker.

### Check-in is course-enabled

Where mobile self-check-in exists, it works only at courses that have enabled it, applies on the day of play, and marks each player individually; otherwise the golfer checks in at the pro shop with the confirmation.

### The platform is not the system of record for the course

The course's tee sheet, check-in desk, and revenue records live in the course's own management system; bookings from every channel — phone, walk-in, the course's own site, and this platform — converge there. What the platform owns is the golfer's side: the account, the reservation record, the payment, the confirmation.
definition.rules_zh:
### 球场规则治理；平台执行规则

取消、编辑和特权规则属于球场，而非平台。重复出现的模式是：自助取消和编辑仅在预订未支付（或不在预付条款下）且超出球场提前截止时间时允许；在截止时间内，更改通过球场或平台支持进行。会员特权——会员可以提前预订多远、可以预订哪些时间、可以带谁——是球场的会员政策，由平台中介化。

### 预付交易以灵活性换取价格

仅在线的折扣开球时间通常在预订时全额收费且不可退款；其条款（球车包含、限制）附加在每个交易上，恶劣天气处理是独立机制（雨支票），而非普通取消。

### 定价按玩家计算，费用另加

费率附加到每个玩家（球场使用会员、客人、老年和类似分类时）；球车和额外项目按玩家附加，除非另有说明；平台预订费可能添加而不改变球场价格。

### 预订是一个命名玩家团体

玩家在预订中被命名，各自收到确认，可以在比赛前添加，并可以自行移除，但受相同截止时间规则约束——预订是团体的共享财产，由预订者锚定。

### 签到由球场启用

在移动自助签到存在的地方，它仅在已启用的球场上工作，适用于比赛当天，并标记每个玩家；否则，高尔夫球手在专业商店凭确认签到。

### 平台不是球场的记录系统

球场的开球时间表、签到台和收入会计都在其自己的系统中。

definition.name: AI Fitness Coach
definition.overview:
An **AI Fitness Coach** is a personal training application in which the software itself performs the coach's job for one trainee: it assesses the person, composes their training plan, guides each workout, and adapts the plan in response to performance, feedback, and real-world constraints.

The problem it solves is the one a human personal trainer would otherwise solve: deciding what to do next, how hard to push, and how training should progress over weeks and months — then adjusting when life interferes. The user brings goals and effort; the application brings the plan, the progression, and the adjustments.

The boundary is structural, not cosmetic. If the software only records what the user chose to do, it is a workout tracker. If a human trainer composes and adjusts the plan, it is a coaching or programming tool for that trainer. If the primary content is a library of instructor-led classes, it is a content platform. An AI Fitness Coach is recognizable when the application itself decides the training and keeps re-deciding it as the trainee changes.
definition.overview_zh:
一个**AI健身教练**是一款个人训练应用，其中软件本身为一名学员执行教练的工作：它评估这个人，制定他们的训练计划，指导每次锻炼，并根据表现、反馈和现实约束来调整计划。

它解决的问题是人类私人教练原本会解决的问题：决定下一步做什么，推动多大强度，以及训练在数周和数月中应如何进展——然后在生活干扰时进行调整。用户带来目标和努力；应用程序带来计划、进度和调整。

边界是结构性的，而非表面性的。如果软件只记录用户选择做的事情，它就是锻炼跟踪器。如果人类教练制定和调整计划，它就是该教练的辅导或编程工具。如果主要内容是教练指导课程库，它就是内容平台。当应用程序本身决定训练并随着学员的变化不断重新决定时，AI健身教练是可识别的。
definition.dc:
### Standard Capabilities

Mature products commonly carry these capabilities. They make the coaching loop practical but do not define the Type:

- **Onboarding assessment** — a questionnaire establishing goals, experience, equipment, and training days before the first plan is generated.
- **Exercise library** — a catalog of exercises with video demonstrations and written form cues, from which sessions are composed.
- **Workout logging** — manual entry of sets/reps/weights, and in some products automatic capture (rep counting, connected resistance).
- **Exercise substitution** — swapping any prescribed exercise for an alternative, typically for equipment, mobility, or preference reasons; some systems learn from these choices.
- **Session adaptation** — regenerating or reshaping the current session under constraints: less time, no equipment, quieter training, easier or harder, avoid certain muscle areas.
- **Recovery / readiness input** — tracking which muscles or systems are recovered and steering the next session toward what is fresh.
- **Progress measurement** — personal records, estimated strength, training volume trends, streaks, and summary scores surfaced back to the user.
- **Goal switching** — changing the training goal (e.g., from general fitness to muscle building) and having the plan re-target automatically.
- **Health-platform integrations** — syncing workouts and body signals with phone health platforms, wearables, and activity-sharing services.
definition.dc_zh:

成熟的产品通常具备这些能力。它们使教练循环变得实用，但并不定义该类型：

- **入职评估** — 一个问卷，在生成第一个计划之前，建立目标、经验、设备和训练日。
- **练习库** — 一个包含视频演示和书面形式提示的练习目录，会话由这些组成。
- **锻炼记录** — 手动输入组数/次数/重量，以及在某些产品中自动捕获（计数次数、连接阻力）。
- **练习替换** — 将任何规定的练习替换为替代方案，通常由于设备、灵活性或偏好原因；一些系统会从这些选择中学习。

definition.rules:
### The equipment inventory is a binding constraint

The coach composes only from what the trainee declared available. Changing the equipment setting changes what can be prescribed; training somewhere new typically means updating the inventory first.

### Adaptation is recovery-aware

Mature products steer subsequent sessions away from muscle groups or systems that were recently trained hard, and toward what has recovered. This is a core coaching behavior, whether computed from logged workouts alone or enriched with wearable data.

### The user can always override the coach

Every researched product exposes override controls — swap, skip, regenerate, adjust difficulty, exclude movements. The coach proposes; the trainee disposes. Overrides themselves can become signals the system learns from.

### Coaching is not medical advice

Products consistently frame the coach as fitness guidance, not clinical care. Injury-related options carry explicit warnings to consult a professional; exercise substitution is offered as the mechanism for limitations rather than diagnosis.

### Manual logging coexists with the coach

Workouts done outside the plan can be logged and counted toward progress, so the adaptation loop sees the trainee's real activity, not only prescribed sessions.

### In hybrid products, AI recommendations may defer to human-led programs

Where a product carries both human-coached programs and AI-generated sessions, the AI recommendation may step aside while an active program is in progress. This behavior is product-specific; the general point is that the two coaching layers are designed to coexist rather than compete.
definition.rules_zh:
### 设备清单是约束条件

教练仅根据学员声明可用的内容制定。更改设备设置会改变可以规定的内容；在新地方训练通常意味着先更新清单。

### 适应是恢复感知的

成熟产品会引导后续会话远离最近高强度训练的肌肉群或系统，转向已恢复的部分。这是核心教练行为，无论是仅从记录的锻炼计算，还是通过可穿戴数据丰富。

### 用户总是可以覆盖教练

所有研究的产品都暴露覆盖控制——交换、跳过、再生、调整难度、排除动作。教练提议；学员决定。覆盖本身可以成为系统学习的信号。

### 教练不是医疗建议

产品始终将教练定位为健身指导，而非临床护理。与伤害相关的选项带有明确警告，建议咨询专业人士；锻炼替代作为限制的机制提供，而非诊断。

### 手动记录与教练共存

计划外完成的锻炼可以记录并计入进度，因此适应循环看到学员的真实活动，而不仅仅是规定的会话。

### 在混合产品中，AI推荐可能让步于人类主导的计划

当产品同时包含人类教练计划和AI生成的会话时，AI推荐可能在活跃计划进行中时让步。此行为是产品特定的；一般点是两个教练层旨在共存而非竞争。

definition.name: Corporate Wellness Platform
definition.overview:
A **Corporate Wellness Platform** is employer-side software for operating a workplace wellness program. The organization — directly, or through a wellness provider acting on its behalf — procures and configures the platform, enrolls an eligible employee population, and delivers a catalog of wellbeing activities: challenges, health assessments, educational content, coaching, screenings, and everyday health behaviors that employees log. Each employee's participation is recorded and, where the program includes incentives, verified and converted into rewards. The organization steers the program through an administrative console and sees results as aggregate reporting; personal health data stays with the participant.

The defining core is small:

```text
Organization-sponsored wellness program
└── Eligible, enrolled employee population (individually activated)
    └── Program activity catalog (challenges · assessments · content · coaching · screenings)
        └── Recorded per-employee participation
            ├── personal feedback & rewards → the employee
            └── aggregate program reporting → the organization
```

Remove the sponsoring organization and the platform collapses into a consumer fitness app; remove enrollment and eligibility and it becomes a public content site; remove participation records and it is a wellness content library; remove the operator console and aggregate reporting and there is no program left to run.

The platform is distinct from consumer fitness products by its dual audience (the organization operates, the employee participates), from engagement-survey tools by delivering activities rather than measuring attitudes, and from benefits administration by managing program participation rather than plan enrollment.
definition.overview_zh:
一个**企业健康平台**是雇主方用于运营工作场所健康计划的软件。该组织——直接或通过代表其行事的健康服务提供商——采购并配置平台，注册符合条件的员工群体，并提供一系列健康活动目录：挑战、健康评估、教育内容、教练指导、筛查以及员工记录的日常健康行为。每位员工的参与情况都会被记录下来，并且，当计划包含激励措施时，其参与会被验证并转化为奖励。该组织通过管理控制台来指导计划，并通过汇总报告查看结果；个人健康数据则保留在参与者手中。

其定义性核心结构如下：

```text
企业赞助的健康计划
└── 符合条件且已注册的员工群体（个人激活）
    └── 计划活动目录（挑战·评估·内容·教练·筛查）
        └── 记录每位员工的参与情况
            ├── 个人反馈与奖励 → 面向员工
            └── 汇总计划报告 → 面向企业
```

移除赞助企业，平台就沦为一款消费者健身应用；移除注册和资格条件，它就变成了一个公共内容网站；移除参与记录，它就是一个健康内容库；移除管理控制台和汇总报告，就不再有可运营的计划了。

该平台与消费级健身产品的区别在于其双重受众（企业运营，员工参与）；与员工敬业度调查工具的区别在于它提供活动而非测量态度；与福利管理系统的区别在于它管理的是计划参与情况，而非计划注册。
definition.dc: The central configured object is the **program**: the organization's wellness offering as a whole. The program carries the organization's branding (mature products allow the participant experience to be fully re-branded), its eligible population, its participation and incentive rules, and its portfolio of activities. A program runs continuously across program years, while individual **challenges** are time-boxed campaigns inside it — typically a few weeks, themed around steps, fitness, nutrition, mindfulness, or company events.
definition.dc_zh: 核心配置对象是**计划**：即组织的整体健康服务。该计划承载组织的品牌标识（成熟产品可将参与者体验进行完全重新品牌化）、其参与群体、参与和激励规则，以及活动组合。一个计划在多个计划年度内持续运行，而内部的个体**挑战**则是有时间限制的活动——通常持续数周，主题围绕步数、健身、营养、正念或公司活动展开。
definition.rules:
### Eligibility gates participation

Only members of the organization's defined population can activate an account. Rosters synchronize from HR/payroll systems; joiners appear, leavers are deactivated. Some programs carry genuinely complex eligibility (multiple employer groups, member populations, divisions) — a defining concern for operator-layer deployments.

### Rewards follow verified participation

Where incentives exist, value is paid only on participation the platform can trust: device-synced data, verified check-ins, reviewed documentation, or administrative approval. This verification-before-reward discipline is the structural rule that keeps incentive programs defensible.

### The organization sees aggregates, not individuals

Individual assessment answers, health metrics, and coaching content belong to the participant. The organization's reporting is aggregate — participation counts, engagement rates, de-identified assessment summaries. This split is what makes the product a wellness program rather than workforce health monitoring; some products withhold even aggregates when a group is too small to be anonymous.

### Challenges are time-boxed; programs are continuous

Challenges run in defined windows with start and end dates; ongoing incentive programs accrue continuously. The two rhythms coexist: campaigns create engagement spikes, the continuous program sustains long-term behavior change.

### Participation is voluntary

The platform offers and encourages; it does not compel. Program design (rewards, social features, communications) is the lever the organization holds.

### Health data is handled as sensitive

Security posture (encryption, role-based access, certifications such as ISO 27001 or HIPAA where applicable) is a visible, marketed property of this software category, because the platform necessarily touches personal health information.
definition.rules_zh:
### 资格决定参与权

只有组织所定义群体内的成员才能激活账户。名册从人力资源/薪酬系统同步；新员工加入时出现，离职员工被停用。一些计划涉及真正复杂的资格条件（多个雇主群体、成员群体、部门）——这是运营层部署需要定义和关注的核心问题。

### 奖励基于经验证的参与

如果存在激励措施，只对平台可信赖的参与发放奖励：设备同步的数据、经验证的签到、经审核的文件或管理员批准。这种“先验证后奖励”的准则，是激励计划得以合理执行的结构性规则。

### 企业看到的是汇总数据，而非个人数据

个人评估答案、健康指标和教练内容属于参与者个人。企业的报告是汇总性的——参与计数、参与率、去标识化的评估摘要。这种区分使得该产品成为一个健康计划，而非劳动力健康监控工具；当某个小组人数太少无法匿名时，一些产品甚至会隐藏汇总数据。

### 挑战是限时的；计划是持续的

挑战在明确的起止日期窗口内运行；持续性激励计划则持续累积。两种节奏共存：活动创造参与峰值，持续性计划维持长期行为改变。

### 参与是自愿的

平台提供并鼓励参与；但不强制。计划设计（奖励、社交功能、沟通策略）是企业掌握的调控杠杆。

### 健康数据被作为敏感信息处理

definition.name: Cycling Application
definition.overview:
A **Cycling Application** is an end-user application whose world is organized around the bicycle ride. It gives an individual cyclist a persistent record of the rides they actually did — or plans to do — carrying cycling-specific performance data, and builds the surrounding experience on that record: maps and tracks, bike-aware route planning and navigation, device connectivity, gear management, analysis, and, in many products, a social or training layer on top.

The defining structure is deliberately small:

```text
Ride (the unit of record)
└── cycling-specific performance semantics
    └── originating from the rider's own riding
```

Everything else commonly associated with cycling software — GPS track display, route planners, turn-by-turn navigation, bike computers, FTP and power analysis, segments and leaderboards, virtual indoor worlds, social feeds — is widespread in current products but is not part of what makes the application a Cycling Application. A manual ride log without GPS, a navigation-first route planner, and an indoor virtual-training product all satisfy the same core.

When the ride record stops being the unit of record — because the product is really a device hub, a coach's plan, an event organizer, or a general social feed — it has drifted toward a different Application Type.
definition.overview_zh:
一个**骑行应用程序**是一种以骑行活动为核心的终端用户应用。它为个人骑行者提供了一个持久的记录，记录他们实际进行过——或计划进行的——骑行活动，并携带骑行特有的性能数据，并在此记录的基础上构建周边体验：地图与轨迹、自行车感知的路线规划与导航、设备连接、装备管理、分析，以及许多产品中在基础功能之上叠加的社交或训练层。

其定义性结构刻意设计得非常简洁：

```text
骑行活动（记录单元）
└── 骑行特有的性能语义
    └── 源自骑行者自身的骑行行为
```

所有通常与骑行软件相关的其他内容——GPS轨迹显示、路线规划器、逐段导航、自行车码表、FTP与功率分析、路段与排行榜、虚拟室内世界、社交信息流——在当前产品中普遍存在，但它们并非构成该应用成为骑行应用程序的必要组成部分。一个没有GPS的手动骑行日志、一个以导航为主的路线规划器、以及一个室内虚拟训练产品，都满足相同的核心定义。

当骑行记录不再是记录单元时——因为该产品实际上是一个设备中心、教练计划、活动组织者或通用社交信息流——它就已经向不同的应用类型漂移。
definition.dc:
- **GPS track and map** — the ride is drawn on a map; maps offer layers, and rides accumulate into personal heatmaps or yearly recaps in some products.
- **Route planning** — the rider builds routes by placing start, destination, and intermediate waypoints; the planner routes according to the chosen cycling sport (favoring paved roads for road cycling, trails for mountain biking), offers round trips and reversed directions, and surfaces elevation profile, surfaces, way types, estimated duration and difficulty, sometimes weather and alerts along the way.
- **Navigation** — a saved route is followed during the ride, with turn cues, offline map support, and re-routing when the rider deviates.
- **Device connectivity** — pairing and syncing with bike computers, smartwatches, power meters, smart trainers, and e-bike systems; rides flow between device and application in both directions.
- **Gear and bike management** — bikes (and shoes, in multi-sport products) as named gear records with accumulated mileage; deeper products model individual bike components (wheels, chains, drivetrain parts) and retire them when replaced. Some products let a gear item be the default for a given sport type.
- **Analysis and progress** — ride-detail surfaces (metrics, splits, elevation, map) and longer-horizon progress: totals, trends, personal bests; power-meter products add threshold-based intensity, training load, power curves, and fitness modeling.
- **Social and community layer** — following other riders, a feed of activities, clubs or groups, challenges, and in some products competition on specific stretches of road or trail (segments with leaderboards).
- **Commerce** — a free base with subscription tiers or region unlocks; some models extend to hardware or recap products.
definition.dc_zh:
- **GPS轨迹与地图** — 骑行被绘制在地图上；地图提供图层，并且骑行累积成个人热力图或年度回顾，在某些产品中。
- **路线规划** — 骑行者通过放置起点、目的地和中间路径点来构建路线；规划器根据所选的骑行运动类型（公路自行车偏好铺装道路，山地自行车偏好小径）进行路线规划，提供往返和反向路线，并显示海拔剖面、路面、道路类型、估计时长和难度，有时还有沿途天气和警报。
- **导航** — 在骑行过程中跟随保存的路线，提供转弯提示、离线地图支持，以及当骑行者偏离时重新规划路线。
- **设备连接** — 与自行车码表、智能手表、功率计、智能训练器和电动自行车系统配对和同步；骑行数据在设备和应用程序之间双向流动。
- **装备与自行车管理** — 自行车（以及鞋子，在多运动产品中）作为命名的装备记录，累积里程；更深入的产品对单个自行车组件（车轮、链条、传动部件）进行建模，并在更换时淘汰。某些产品允许装备项作为特定运动类型的默认装备。
- **分析与进展** — 骑行详情显示（指标、分段、海拔、地图）和更长期的进展：总计、趋势、个人最佳；功率计产品添加基于阈值的强度，
definition.rules:
### Sport type governs interpretation

The cycling sport label of a ride (and of a planned route) determines how the system treats it: which metrics are emphasized, how routes are routed, how duration and difficulty are estimated. Changing the sport type after the fact is a normal, supported operation.

### Every product offers several ways in, one canonical record

Recording live, syncing a device, importing a file, entering manually, and riding indoors all end in the same place: one persisted ride record. Editing after the fact is expected — rides are corrected, re-typed, and re-assigned without losing their identity.

### Privacy is structural

Rides reveal where a person lives, rides, and when. Visibility of rides (and even of ride start times or gear) is a configurable surface in mature products, not an afterthought. Products that push rides to social feeds carry additional privacy weight.

### Equipment mileage is derived, not typed

Gear mileage accumulates from the rides assigned to that gear. Riders cannot simply type a total; historical mileage is brought in by assigning (possibly manual) rides to the gear item. Components retire in ways that preserve or restructure the bike record depending on the product.

### Physical conditions are estimates and warnings, not guarantees

Route surface types, elevation, estimated durations, and difficulty reflect map data and models; planners explicitly treat them as preferences and estimates. Real-world conditions can diverge — which is why route alerts, user-reported conditions, and re-routing during navigation exist.

### Offline is a first-class case

Riding happens where connectivity is poor. Navigation on saved routes and map display commonly work offline, with maps or regions prepared in advance; sync resumes when connectivity returns.
definition.rules_zh:
### 运动类型决定解读方式

骑行活动的运动类型标签（以及规划路线的类型）决定了系统如何处理它：强调哪些指标、路线如何规划、时长和难度如何估算。事后更改运动类型是一个正常的、受支持的操作。

### 每个产品都提供多种入口，但只有一个规范记录

实时记录、同步设备、导入文件、手动输入以及室内骑行，最终都指向同一个地方：一条持久化的骑行记录。事后编辑是预期中的——骑行记录可以被纠正、重新分类和重新分配，而不会丢失其身份。

### 隐私是结构性的

骑行记录揭示了一个人居住、骑行的地点和时间。骑行活动的可见性（甚至骑行开始时间或装备）在成熟产品中是一个可配置的选项，而非事后考虑。将骑行活动推送到社交信息流的产品承担着额外的隐私责任。

### 装备里程是派生的，而非手动输入的

装备的里程从分配给该装备的骑行活动中累积而来。骑行者无法简单地输入一个总数；历史里程通过将（可能是手动的）骑行记录分配给装备条目来引入。部件退役的方式根据产品不同，会保留或重构自行车记录。

### 物理条件是估计值和警示，而非保证

路线的路面类型、高程、估计时长和难度反映的是地图数据和模型；规划器明确将其视为偏好设置和估计值。现实世界中的条件可能会有差异——这就是为什么路线提醒、用户报告的状况以及导航期间的重新规划功能会存在。

### 离线是一等公民功能

骑行活动常发生在网络连接不佳的地方。使用保存的路线进行导航以及地图显示通常可以离线工作，需提前准备地图或区域；当网络恢复时，同步会继续。

definition.name: Endurance Training Platform
definition.overview:
An **Endurance Training Platform** is a system of record for the endurance training process. It holds the athlete's planned training schedule as the governing object, captures completed workouts against that plan, and accumulates the resulting training state over time — so that the next planning decision is informed by what training has actually happened, across one or several endurance sports (running, cycling, swimming, triathlon, rowing and related disciplines).

The defining structure is small:

```text
Athlete (+ optional Coach)
└── Training plan / calendar — the plan of record, persisting across the season
    └── Planned workout — prescribed before it is executed
        └── Completed workout — captured against the prescription
            └── Accumulated training state — load, fitness and trends over time
                └── feeds the next planning decision
```

Everything else commonly associated with these products — power and heart-rate metrics, structured interval files, trainer-platform sync, adaptive AI planning, wellness data, team social walls — is widespread in current products but is not what makes the product this Type. A coach mailing weekly plan sheets that an athlete answers with a completed training diary satisfies the same structure without any of those specifics.

When the center of gravity shifts to a single sport's activity record (the ride, the run, the swim as the unit of record), the product is drifting toward a sport-specific training application. When software itself performs the coach loop — composing and adapting training as its defining property — the product is drifting toward an AI fitness coach.
definition.overview_zh:
一个**耐力训练平台**是耐力训练过程中的记录系统。它将运动员的计划训练时间表作为管理对象，捕捉相对于该计划的已完成训练，并随时间累积由此产生的训练状态——以便下一个规划决策能基于实际发生的训练，跨越一个或多个耐力运动（跑步、骑行、游泳、铁人三项、划船及相关学科）。

其定义结构很小：

```text
运动员（+ 可选教练）
└── 训练计划 / 日历 — 记录的计划，持续整个赛季
    └── 计划训练 — 在执行前规定
        └── 完成训练 — 相对于规定被捕获
            └── 累积训练状态 — 负荷、体能和趋势随时间推移
                └── 反馈到下一个规划决策
```

其他通常与这些产品相关的一切——功率和心率指标、结构化间歇文件、训练器-平台同步、自适应AI规划、健康数据、团队社交墙——在当前产品中很普遍，但并不是使产品成为这种**类型**的关键。一个教练邮寄每周计划表，运动员用完成训练日记回复，同样满足此结构，而无需那些具体功能。

当重心转移到单一运动的活动记录（骑行、跑步、游泳作为记录单元）时，产品正向特定运动训练应用偏移。当软件本身执行教练循环——以组合和调整训练作为其定义属性——产品正向AI健身教练偏移。
definition.dc:
Three structures. If any one is removed, the product is no longer recognizable as an endurance training platform:

- **The planned training schedule as plan of record.** A dated, persistent calendar of prescribed workouts that exists *before* execution and accumulates across weeks and the season. Someone authors it — the athlete, a human coach, a template or marketplace plan, or an algorithm — but the author is not what defines the object. Without a governing plan the product becomes a workout tracker that logs the past.
- **The workout as a planned-vs-completed unit.** Each planned workout can be executed — indoors on a trainer, outdoors, guided or free — and its completion is captured by device/file sync or manual entry and held *against the prescription*. That the platform can always express "what was planned vs what was done" is the loop's hinge. Without it the product becomes a plan-delivery service or a disconnected log.
- **Accumulated training-state accounting.** Completed training aggregates over time into load, progression and state views — however computed or however much is delegated to the coach's judgment — and those views feed the next planning decision. The platform, not a spreadsheet beside it, carries the training state across the season. Without it the product becomes a one-shot plan generator.
definition.dc_zh:
三个结构。如果任何一个被移除，该产品将不再被识别为耐力训练平台：

- **作为记录计划的计划训练日程。** 一个有日期的、持久的预定锻炼日历，在执行前存在，并在几周和整个季节中累积。它由某人创建——运动员、人类教练、模板或市场计划、或算法——但创建者并不定义该对象。如果没有一个管理计划，该产品将成为记录过去的锻炼追踪器。
- **作为计划-完成单元的锻炼。** 每个计划锻炼都可以执行——在室内训练器上、户外、有指导或自由——其完成通过设备/文件同步或手动输入捕获，并*与处方对照*。平台能够始终表达“计划了什么 vs 完成了什么”是循环的枢纽。如果没有它，该产品将成为计划交付服务或不连贯的日志。
- **累积的训练状态核算。** 完成的训练随时间聚合成负荷、进展和状态视图——无论计算方式如何或多少委托给教练的判断——这些视图为下一个计划决策提供信息。平台，而不是旁边的电子表格，跨季节携带训练状态。如果没有它，该产品将成为一次性计划生成器。
definition.rules:
### The plan precedes the workout

Prescription comes first in the object model: a completed workout is recorded *against* a planned one. Unplanned training is captured too, but is visibly marked as unplanned — the distinction between the plan and what actually happened is a first-class, user-visible state.

### Compliance is explicit

The platform compares completed values with planned values and surfaces the result on the record (color or score). Exact thresholds for what counts as "on plan" vary by product.

### Thresholds anchor the metrics

Per-sport threshold values drive zone and load computation. When a threshold changes, derived metrics change with it; mature products detect likely threshold changes from performances and offer to apply them. Stale thresholds quietly distort every derived number — a known operational risk of the Type.

### The loop absorbs imperfection

Missed workouts, extra sessions, sickness and travel are recorded as deviations and folded back into planning rather than breaking the record. The adaptation response differs by product philosophy — coach judgment, athlete edit, or automatic re-planning — but the record itself is never silently rewritten.

### Adaptation authority is a philosophy, not a feature flag

Products differ on who moves the plan: a human coach, the athlete, or the system. Most products allow more than one authority at once (a coach adjusting an algorithm-generated plan, for instance).

### Capture has a fallback

Device and platform autosync is the default capture path, but manual entry and file upload preserve the loop when devices are absent — historically the original path, and still supported across the sample.
definition.rules_zh:
### 计划先于训练

规定在对象模型中优先：完成的训练是相对于计划训练记录的。未计划的训练也被捕获，但被明显标记为未计划——计划与实际发生之间的区别是一等的、用户可见的状态。

### 合规性是显式的

平台将完成值与计划值比较，并在记录上呈现结果（颜色或分数）。什么算作“按计划”的确切阈值因产品而异。

### 阈值锚定指标

每项运动的阈值驱动区域和负荷计算。当阈值改变时，衍生指标也随之改变；成熟的产品从表现中检测可能的阈值变化并建议应用它们。过时的阈值悄然扭曲每个衍生数字——这是该类型已知的操作风险。

### 循环吸收不完美

错过的训练、额外的训练、疾病和旅行被记录为偏差并重新纳入规划，而非破坏记录。适应响应因产品理念而异——教练判断、运动员编辑或自动重新规划——但记录本身从不被静默重写。

### 适应权威是一种哲学，而非功能标志

产品在谁移动计划上不同：人类教练、运动员或系统。大多数产品允许多个权威同时存在（例如，教练调整算法生成的计划）。

### 捕获有后备方案

设备和平台自动同步是默认捕获路径，但当设备缺失时，手动输入和文件上传保留循环——历史上是原始路径，仍在样本中普遍支持。

definition.name: Fitness Assessment Application
definition.overview:
A **Fitness Assessment Application** is the assessor-side system of record for structured fitness evaluation. It lets a professional — a personal trainer, strength coach, physical-education teacher, coach, or clinician — evaluate a person's physical condition against a defined set of tests, record the results on that person's record, interpret them against standards or baselines, and re-administer the same evaluation over time to show change.

The defining core is small:

```text
Assessment protocol (defined battery of tests + how to administer them)
└── administered to an identified person (client / student / athlete)
    └── assessment record (that person's results at a point in time)
        └── interpreted against an evaluative reference
            (standards, norms, scoring rules, baseline)
```

Four properties, held together. Remove the protocol and the product becomes a progress log or a notes app. Remove the person-bound record and it becomes a calculator or a paper form. Remove the evaluative reference — the thing that turns "30 cm" into "within the healthy zone" or "a priority to address" — and it becomes a raw measurement log. Everything commonly associated with modern assessment products — protocol video libraries, client-facing reports, automated workout delivery, instrumented testing hardware, institutional mandates — is widespread but not what makes the product an assessment application.

When the center of gravity shifts to the person's self-tracked body metrics, the client business relationship, the organizational training program, or the analysis of performance data, the product is drifting toward a different Application Type (Fitness Progress Tracker, Personal Training Management, Athlete Management System, Sports Performance Analytics).
definition.overview_zh:
一款 **健身评估应用** 是用于结构化健身评估的评估方系统记录。它允许专业人士——私人教练、力量教练、体育教师、教练或临床医生——根据一套明确的测试项目来评估个人的身体状况，将结果记录在该个人的档案中，依据标准或基线进行解读，并在一段时间内重新执行相同的评估以展示变化。

其核心定义是精简的：

```text
评估方案（定义的一组测试项目及实施方法）
└── 对已识别的个人（客户/学生/运动员）实施
    └── 评估记录（该个人在某个时间点的结果）
        └── 根据评估参考依据进行解读
            （标准、常模、评分规则、基线）
```

四个属性，紧密结合。移除方案，产品就变成了进度日志或笔记应用。移除与个人绑定的记录，它就变成了计算器或纸质表格。移除评估参考依据——那个将“30厘米”转化为“处于健康范围”或“需要优先关注”的东西——它就变成了一个原始测量日志。所有通常与现代评估产品相关联的东西——方案视频库、面向客户的报告、自动化训练交付、仪器化测试硬件、机构要求——都很常见，但并非构成评估应用产品的核心要素。

当重心转移到个人自我追踪的身体指标、客户业务关系、组织化训练计划或表现数据分析时，该产品就正在向不同的应用类型（健身进度追踪器、私人训练管理、运动员管理系统、运动表现分析）漂移。
definition.dc:
**Assessment protocol.** A defined battery of tests and measures — what is evaluated, and how each test is administered and scored. The protocol exists before and independent of any single assessment: a trainer's standard intake evaluation, a school's fitness test battery, a standardized movement screen, a force-plate test suite. Protocols may be maintained by the vendor, adopted from a standards body, or authored by the assessing professional. In one institutional product the protocol is assembled per assessment occasion from a library of test items with recommended battery combinations; in a screening product the protocol is a fixed, standardized screen whose value lies precisely in being administered the same way every time.

**The assessed person.** An identified individual whose results accumulate over time: a client in a training business, a student in a class, an athlete on a team roster. Person attributes matter to interpretation — one institutional product uses the person's age at the assessment date to select which standards apply. People are usually organized into groups (classes, teams, client lists) because assessments are typically delivered to groups even though results belong to individuals.

**The assessment record.** The intersection of protocol, person, and point in time: the results captured when a specific person is assessed on a specific battery on a specific date. This is the central object of the Type. In an institutional product it takes the form of a named, dated assessment event spanning selected groups, into which results are entered per person and per test item. In trainer-side products it is an assessment instance attached to a client. In instrumented testing it is a test session whose measurements flow from the device into the person's record. Results can be entered per person or per group; subjects can be exempted from individual test items.

**The evaluative reference.** What turns recorded values into evaluation. This takes different forms across products: criterion-referenced health standards (a value falls inside or outside a "healthy zone" defined for the person's age and sex), norm comparisons, formal scoring rules combined into an interpretive algorithm, asymmetry or baseline comparisons from instrumented measurements, or the professional's structured rating scales. The output is always the same kind of thing: a rating, zone, score, or flag that carries meaning for a decision — what to train, what to protect, what to report, what to re-test.
definition.dc_zh:
**评估协议。** 一个定义好的测试和测量组合——评估什么，以及每个测试如何管理和评分。协议在任何单次评估之前就存在，且独立于它：教练的标准入学评估、学校的体能测试组合、标准化的动作筛查、力板测试套件。协议可以由供应商维护、从标准机构采用，或由评估专业人员编写。在一个机构产品中，协议根据评估场合从测试项目库中组装，带有推荐的组合；在一个筛查产品中，协议是固定的标准化筛查，其价值恰恰在于每次管理方式相同。

**被评估的人。** 一个被识别的个体，其结果随时间累积：训练业务中的客户、班级中的学生、运动队中的运动员。人的属性对解释很重要——一个机构产品使用评估日期时的年龄来选择适用的标准。人通常被组织成小组（班级、团队、客户列表），因为评估通常针对小组进行，而结果属于个人。

**评估记录。** 协议、人和时间点的交点：当特定人在特定组合上在特定场合被评估时捕获的结果。
definition.rules:
### Results are point-in-time and person-bound

Every result belongs to one identified person at one date. The assessment date is not cosmetic: in at least one institutional product, the event's end date determines the person's age for standard selection and appears on the personal report as the assessment date.

### Comparability requires the same protocol

Progress comparison is meaningful only between assessments on the same protocol. This is why products push consistent administration (protocol videos, administration cues, standardized screens) and why an institutional product warns against fragmenting a battery into separate single-test events.

### The reference is age- and population-sensitive

Standards and norms are defined per population segment — typically age and sex — not universally. The application, not the assessor, usually performs this selection.

### The assessor controls the record; the subject sees their own results

Recording and editing results is the assessor's role. The assessed person, where they have access, sees their own reports — a read-facing surface, not an entry surface. In institutional contexts, fitness data about minors carries privacy obligations, and products advertise compliance postures accordingly.

### Assessment is not programming

The assessment record evaluates; it does not itself constitute a training program. The link to programming — corrective exercises, plan adjustments — is a downstream handoff, automated in some products and human-mediated in others.

### Exemptions and missing data are first-class

Not every person can complete every test item. Products that serve institutions treat exemptions as recorded, visible states rather than blank cells.
definition.rules_zh:
### 结果是时间点绑定且与个人相关的

每个结果都归属于一个已识别的个人和一个日期。评估日期并非装饰性：在至少一个机构产品中，活动的结束日期决定了个人用于选择标准的年龄，并作为评估日期出现在个人报告上。

### 可比性要求使用相同方案

进度比较仅在相同方案下的评估之间才有意义。这就是为什么产品强调一致的执行（方案视频、执行提示、标准化界面），以及为什么机构产品警告不要将一个组合方案拆分为单独的单项测试事件。

### 参考依据是年龄和人群敏感的

标准和常模是按人群细分定义的——通常是年龄和性别——而非通用。应用程序（而非评估员）通常执行此选择。

### 评估员控制记录；受试者查看自己的结果

记录和编辑结果是评估员的职责。被评估者（如果他们有访问权限）查看的是自己的报告——一个只读界面，而非录入界面。在机构环境中，涉及未成年人的健身数据具有隐私义务，产品会相应地宣传其合规性。

### 评估不是训练计划

评估记录用于评估；其本身并不构成训练计划。与训练计划的关联——纠正性练习、计划调整——是下游交接环节，在某些产品中是自动化的，在其他产品中则需人工协调。

### 豁免和缺失数据是一等公民

并非每个人都能完成每个测试项目。服务于机构的产品将豁免视为已记录的、可见的状态，而非空白单元格。

definition.name: Fitness Progress Tracker
definition.overview:
A **Fitness Progress Tracker** is an application that keeps one person's body and fitness measurements as dated entries over time and renders those entries as progress — trend lines, comparisons against earlier values, and movement toward targets.

It exists because fitness progress is invisible in any single reading. Weight fluctuates daily, body measurements drift slowly, and a photograph or a benchmark lift means little without the ones that came before. The application's job is to accumulate these readings into a longitudinal record and make the change visible and interpretable — often specifically to keep the person motivated when day-to-day numbers look flat.

The Type is bounded by what it does not do. The numbers it holds are **raw personal measurements**: there is no defined test battery, no evaluator scoring the person, and no comparison against population standards or norms. The only reference points are the person's own earlier values and the goals they (or their coach) set. When structured, scored fitness evaluation is the center of a product, that is the separate Fitness Assessment Application territory — the two frequently coexist as distinct modules in the same platform.
definition.overview_zh:
一个**健身进度追踪器**是一种应用程序，它保存一个人的身体和健身测量数据作为随时间变化的带日期条目，并将这些条目呈现为进度——趋势线、与早期值的比较以及向目标的移动。

它存在是因为健身进度在任何单次读数中是不可见的。体重每天波动，身体测量值缓慢漂移，一张照片或一次基准举重如果没有之前的对比就意义不大。该应用程序的工作是将这些读数累积成一个纵向记录，使变化可见且可解释——通常特别用于在每日数字看起来平稳时保持个人的动力。

该类型的边界由其不做的事情决定。它保存的数字是**原始的个人测量数据**：没有定义的测试组合，没有评估者对个人进行评分，也没有与人群标准或规范进行比较。唯一的参考点是个人自己的早期值和他们（或他们的教练）设定的目标。当结构化的、评分的健身评估是产品的中心时，那就是单独的健身评估应用程序领域——两者经常作为同一平台中的不同模块共存。
definition.dc:
- **Goals and targets** — a target value for a metric, shown on the chart as a reference line, optionally broken into milestone sub-goals. The most common reference point, though progress against one's own earlier values is an equally valid reference without any goal.
- **Custom metric definitions** — a catalog of pre-defined metrics (weight, common body measurements, device metrics) plus the ability to define additional metrics with a name and unit; in coaching products, named groups of metrics assigned to a client.
- **Trend derivation** — smoothing or averaging over raw entries (weekly averages, moving averages) so that ordinary daily fluctuation does not mask the underlying direction.
- **Entry conveniences** — recording several metrics in one pass, editing or deleting past entries, week and all-entries views over the history.
- **Progress photos** — a dated photo timeline compared across time; common in coaching and business-oriented realizations, absent from minimal weight trackers.
- **Device and platform data import** — weights from connected scales, steps/sleep/heart-rate families from wearables or health platforms.
- **Prompting machinery** — reminders or recurring tasks so that entries keep arriving; import automation serving the same goal.
- **Predictions** — in some trend-focused products, projections of when a target will be reached if the current trend continues.
- **Privacy controls** — the record is sensitive personal body data; profile locking and per-person visibility are common, and explicit consent mechanisms appear where photos may be reused beyond the person's own record.
definition.dc_zh:
- **目标与指标** — 某个指标的目标值，在图表中显示为参考线，可选择分解为里程碑子目标。这是最常见的参考点，尽管与自己之前值的进展同样是一个有效的参考，无需任何目标。
- **自定义指标定义** — 预定义指标（体重、常见身体测量、设备指标）的目录，加上定义额外指标的名称和单位的能力；在教练产品中，分配给客户的命名指标组。
- **趋势推导** — 对原始条目进行平滑或平均处理（周平均值、移动平均值），使日常波动不会掩盖基本方向。
- **条目便利性** — 一次性记录多个指标，编辑或删除过去的条目，查看历史数据的周视图和全部条目视图。
- **进度照片** — 跨时间比较的带日期照片时间线；在教练和面向商业的实现中常见，在最小体重追踪器中缺失。
- **设备和平台数据导入** — 来自连接秤的体重，来自可穿戴设备或健康平台的步数/睡眠/心率系列。
- **提示机制** — 提醒或重复任务，使条目持续到达；导入自动化服务于同一目标。
- **预测** — 在一些趋势聚焦的产品中，预测如果当前趋势持续，目标何时会被达到。
definition.rules:
- **Entries are recorded, never scored.** The application stores and renders values; it does not rate them against standards, norms, or an assessor's criteria. This absence is structural, not incidental.
- **The record belongs to one person.** Progress is defined per person; the core product does not compare one person's body metrics against another's. (Leaderboards and challenges, where present in business platforms, are engagement features layered on top, not part of the record.)
- **The record is correctable, entry by entry.** Past readings can be edited or deleted, and trend views recompute from the surviving entries. The product keeps the user in control of the data rather than treating entries as immutable clinical facts.
- **Presentation is layered on the record, not substituted for it.** Smoothing and averaging change how the series is read; the raw entries remain inspectable underneath.
- **The data is sensitive personal body data.** Products provide privacy controls appropriate to personal use (profile locks, per-person visibility), and where progress photos might be reused beyond the person's own record — for instance as marketing material by a fitness business — explicit consent is captured.
- **Continuity is the success condition.** The record's value compounds with regular entries; sparse records yield flat, unreadable trends. This drives the reminder, task, and import machinery that mature products attach to the loop.
definition.rules_zh:
- **条目被记录，从不评分。** 应用程序存储和呈现值；它不对这些值进行标准、规范或评估者标准的评级。这种缺失是结构性的，而非偶然的。
- **记录属于一个人。** 进度按个人定义；核心产品不会将一个人的身体指标与另一个人的进行比较。（在商业平台中存在的排行榜和挑战是叠加的参与功能，不是记录的一部分。）
- **记录是可纠正的，逐条目。** 过去的读数可以编辑或删除，趋势视图会从剩余的条目重新计算。产品让用户控制数据，而不是将条目视为不可变的临床事实。
- **呈现层叠在记录之上，而非替代记录。** 平滑和平均改变了系列的读取方式；原始条目在底层仍可检查。
- **数据是敏感的个人身体数据。** 产品提供适合个人使用的隐私控制（个人资料锁、单人可见性），并且在进度照片可能被重复用于个人记录之外——例如作为健身企业的营销材料时——会获取明确同意。
- **连续性是成功条件。** 记录的价值随着定期条目而累积；稀疏的记录会产生平坦、不可读的趋势。这驱动了成熟产品附加到循环中的提醒、任务和导入机制。

definition.name: Food / Calorie Tracking Application
definition.overview:
A **Food / Calorie Tracking Application** is a person-facing application in which an individual records the food and drink they actually consume, the application resolves each entry against a food-and-nutrient dataset into nutrition quantities — calories above all — and continuously compares what was consumed against personally calibrated daily targets.

It solves the problem that nutrition is invisible in daily life: no one can hold in their head what a day of eating adds up to. The application turns "what did I eat?" into numbers, and those numbers into an answer to "where do I stand against my goal today?"

The defining core is deliberately small:

```text
Dated personal food log
└── entries resolved by a nutrition reference layer
    └── compared against daily targets
        └── remaining / over-budget as the daily feedback
```

Everything else commonly associated with these products — barcode scanners, giant food databases, meal plans, wearables, community feeds, AI photo logging — is widespread but not what makes the product this Type. A paper food diary kept together with a printed calorie-reference book satisfies the same core structure; the software digitizes, automates, and enriches it.
definition.overview_zh:
**食品/卡路里追踪应用程序**是一种面向个人的应用程序，用户在其中记录他们实际消费的食物和饮料，应用程序根据食物与营养数据集将每个条目解析为营养数量——尤其是卡路里——并持续将已消费内容与个人校准的每日目标进行比较。

它解决了日常生活中营养不可见的问题：没有人能凭记忆记住一天饮食的总和。该应用程序将“我吃了什么？”转化为数字，再将这些数字转化为“我今天距离目标还有多远？”的答案。

其定义核心刻意精简：

```text
带日期的个人食物日志
└── 由营养参考层解析的条目
    └── 与每日目标比较
        └── 剩余/超支作为每日反馈
```

通常与这些产品相关的其他功能——条形码扫描仪、大型食物数据库、膳食计划、可穿戴设备、社区动态、AI照片记录——虽然普遍存在，但并非定义该产品类型的核心。一本纸质食物日记配合印刷的卡路里参考书同样满足相同的核心结构；软件只是将其数字化、自动化并丰富化。
definition.dc:
Three structures, held jointly. Remove any one and the product stops being this Type:

**1. The food log of record.** A dated, personal record of consumed foods and drinks. Each entry names a specific food, a quantity (serving size and number of servings), and usually a meal slot (breakfast, lunch, dinner, snacks — typically renamable and extendable). Entries are individually addressable: they can be edited, deleted, repeated, and revisited later. The log is the system of record — the thing the whole application exists to accumulate.

**2. The nutrition reference layer.** Every entry is resolved against a body of food/nutrient data into nutrient quantities. Energy (calories) is the canonical minimum that every product computes; macronutrients (protein, carbs, fat) are the standard second layer; micronutrients (vitamins, minerals, and other compounds) are the depth layer that distinguishes data-first products. The reference layer is what turns a written line like "1 cup cooked rice" into numbers.

**3. The daily intake-vs-target loop.** The user carries personally calibrated daily targets — a calorie budget at minimum, commonly macro and micronutrient targets as well. The application's operational output is the running comparison: consumed so far, remaining, over budget. This comparison is what makes the product a *tracker* rather than a journal: it drives the next logging decision and the next food decision.

These three are load-bearing together. A log without the reference layer is a food journal; a reference layer without a log is a calculator; a log and reference without targets is retrospective record-keeping with nothing to track against.
definition.dc_zh:
该类型由三个结构共同构成，缺一则不再是此类型：

**1. 饮食日志主记录：** 一份带日期的、个人化的饮食摄入记录。每条记录需指明具体食物、用量（份量与份数），并通常包含餐次（早餐、午餐、晚餐、加餐——通常可重命名与扩展）。记录条目可独立编辑、删除、重复引用或事后查阅。此日志是系统记录的核心，即整个应用旨在累积的主体数据。

**2. 营养数据参考层：** 每条记录需通过食物/营养成分数据库解析，转化为营养素含量数据。热量（卡路里）是所有产品必算的基础指标；宏量营养素（蛋白质、碳水化合物、脂肪）是标准第二层级；微量营养素（维生素、矿物质及其他化合物）则是区分数据深度型产品的进阶层级。参考层的功能在于将“1杯熟米饭”这样的文字描述转化为具体数值。

**3. 每日摄入量与目标对照循环：** 用户设定个人校准的每日目标——至少包含热量预算，通常还包括宏量与微量营养素目标。应用的运算输出呈现动态对比：已摄入量、剩余量、超支量。此对比机制正是产品从“日志本”升华为“追踪器”的关键：它直接驱动下一次记录决策。
definition.rules:
**The log is correctable history, not immutable record.** Entries — and entire past days — can be edited and deleted. Totals recompute from the corrected entries.

**Everything flows from the quantity model.** Serving size × number of servings is what the whole computation rides on; changing either changes every derived nutrient value. The reference layer's per-serving basis (per 100 g, per item, per portion) is normalized by this model.

**Data quality is a user-visible concern.** The same real-world food can exist as multiple database entries with different values (generic vs brand vs user-submitted). Products manage this with verification, deduplication, and search ranking — and the user is the final arbiter of which entry matches what they actually ate.

**The daily frame is the unit of accountability.** Targets, remaining values, streaks, and the taught behavior ("log everything, even over-budget days") are organized around the day. The taught norm in this Type is completeness over perfection: an honest log of a bad day is treated as success.

**Exercise adjusts the picture, by product-specific accounting.** Whether synced activity raises the day's energy budget, appears as a separate stream, or is deduplicated against device-reported totals varies by product — a user moving between products will find different arithmetic here.

**Custom entries are private by default.** Foods, meals, and recipes a user creates serve that user's diary; sharing them (where offered) is an explicit act.

**The diary is sensitive personal data.** Consumption, weight, and — in condition-focused variants — medication and blood-sugar entries are health-adjacent records; products treat visibility, export, and deletion as first-class settings.
definition.rules_zh:
**日志是可修正的历史，而非不可变的记录。**条目——以及整个过去的日期——可以被编辑和删除。总计会根据修正的条目重新计算。

**一切源于数量模型。**份量×份数是整个计算的基础；更改其中任何一个都会改变每个派生的营养值。参考层的每份基础（每100克、每项、每份）通过此模型标准化。

**数据质量是用户可见的问题。**同一种现实世界的食物可能作为多个数据库条目存在，具有不同值（通用 vs 品牌 vs 用户提交）。产品通过验证、去重和搜索排名来管理这一点——用户是哪个条目匹配其实际所食的最终仲裁者。

**每日框架是问责单位。**目标、剩余值、连续记录和教导的行为（“记录一切，即使超支的日子”）都围绕着一天组织。该类型中教导的规范是完整性优于完美度：对糟糕一天的诚实记录被视为成功。

**运动根据产品特定的核算调整状况。**同步的活动是提升每日能量预算、作为独立数据流出现，还是与设备报告的总计去重，因产品而异——在不同产品间切换的用户会发现此处的算术不同。

**自定义条目默认为私有。**用户创建的食物、餐食和食谱服务于该用户的日记；共享它们（如果提供）是明确行为。

**日记是敏感的个人数据。**消费记录、体重——以及在专注于特定病症的变体中——药物和血糖条目都是健康相关记录；产品将可见性、导出和删除视为一等设置。

definition.name: Golf Tracking / Handicap Application
definition.overview:
A **Golf Tracking / Handicap Application** is the player-side personal record system for golf. It lets an individual golfer record rounds — stroke by stroke, or as a total, against a specific course and tee set — keep those rounds as a persistent scoring history, and derive from that history a personal handicap figure and playing statistics.

It solves a problem specific to golf: performance is measured over time, on courses of very different difficulty, and against a formal ability number (the handicap) that other players, clubs and competitions rely on. The application is the golfer's own system of record for that measurement.

Its boundary: it records and measures what a player does; it does not run the course. Scheduling playing capacity, selling tee times, and settling revenue are the job of operator-side systems (Golf Course Management). This Type is the mirror image — the round as the player experiences and archives it.
definition.overview_zh:
一款**高尔夫追踪/差点应用程序**是高尔夫运动中球员端的个人记录系统。它允许个人高尔夫球员记录每轮比赛——逐洞或汇总成绩，针对特定球场和发球台组——将这些轮次保存为持久的记分历史，并从该历史中推导出个人差点数字和比赛统计数据。

它解决了高尔夫运动特有的一个问题：表现是随着时间的推移来衡量的，在难度差异很大的球场上进行，并基于一个其他玩家、俱乐部和赛事都依赖的正式能力数字（差点）。该应用程序是球员自身用于该衡量的记录系统。

其边界在于：它记录和衡量球员的表现；它并不运营球场。安排打球容量、销售开球时间和结算收入是运营方系统（球场管理）的职责。这个类型是其镜像——即球员体验和存档的每轮比赛。
definition.dc:
```text
Course (named facility)
└── Tee set (per tee: holes, par, yardage, difficulty ratings)
    └── Round record (a dated round played from a tee set)
        ├── Hole scores (strokes per hole; optional per-hole detail)
        └── Posted score (the round as submitted for handicap purposes)
Personal scoring history (the golfer's archive of round records)
└── Handicap figure (maintained from the history under a handicapping method)
    └── Statistics & trends (derived views of the same history)
```

Three structures together make the Type what it is. Remove any one and it stops being recognizable:

- **Course-structured round record** — a round is not a generic "workout": it is a dated round at a named course, played from a specific tee set whose holes carry par, yardage and difficulty ratings. This structure is what makes scores comparable across courses and what everything downstream depends on. Without it, the product is a generic activity tracker.
- **Persistent personal scoring history** — every round the player saves joins a permanent archive. The history is the substrate from which the handicap, the statistics and the trends are all derived. Without it, the product is a disposable scorecard.
- **A maintained handicap figure** — a single personal number, derived from the scoring history under a defined handicapping method, that estimates playing ability and moves as new rounds are posted. In current products this takes two shapes: a figure the application computes itself, or an official index maintained through an authorized handicap service the application posts into. Without it, the product is a round logger with no ability model — the "handicap" half of the Type disappears.
definition.dc_zh:
球场（命名设施）
└── 发球台组（每个发球台：洞数、标准杆、码数、难度评级）
    └── 比赛记录（从一个发球台组进行的有日期的比赛）
        ├── 洞口成绩（每个洞的杆数；可选的每个洞详情）
        └── 提交分数（为差点目的提交的比赛）
个人计分历史（高尔夫球手的比赛记录档案）
└── 差点数值（根据差点方法从历史中维护）
    └── 统计与趋势（同一历史的衍生视图）
definition.rules:
### The handicap is potential-based, not an average

Both products that document the calculation explicitly warn that the figure is built from the player's *better* rounds within a recent window — a few bad rounds barely move it, and one great round can. A round can also drop out of the window as new ones arrive, so the figure can move even after an unremarkable round.

### The same score weighs differently on different courses

Course rating and slope adjust every score before it counts. A 90 on a hard course can be a better result than an 88 on an easy one. Wrong course data therefore corrupts the handicap — which is why products support reporting and correcting course ratings, pars and hole handicaps, and let a player exclude an affected round while data is under review.

### Eligibility rules decide what counts

Round length matters (9-hole rounds are handled as a defined case — converted or combined with another nine), the tee played must carry the required ratings, and rounds can be marked ineligible. In officially-aligned products, special derived records (such as two nines combined into one eighteen-hole score) cannot simply be deleted — the underlying rounds are what gets corrected.

### Hole-by-hole detail changes what the system can do for you

With per-hole scores the application applies the rules' hole-score cap automatically, computes derived statistics, and supports formats. Total-score-only entry still counts for handicap but pushes adjustment work back onto the player.

### Peer review is structural, not social

Official handicapping rests on transparency: in officially-aligned products the scoring record and handicap are visible to other players through a lookup by name or handicap ID. The licensed product documented here keeps this visibility even when the rest of the profile is set to private — scores can be hidden from the social feed but still count and remain visible in the record.

### The record is guarded

Deletion and editing are constrained where the record feeds the official figure. Private-upload options hide a score socially without removing it from the handicap record. Corrections to posted history go through review rather than silent edits.
definition.rules_zh:
### 差点是基于潜力的，而非平均值

明确说明计算方法的两种产品都警告说，该数字是基于球员在最近窗口内*较好*的几轮比赛构建的——少数几场糟糕的比赛几乎不会影响它，而一场出色的比赛则可能产生较大影响。随着新轮次的加入，某轮比赛也可能移出窗口，因此即使在一场表现平平的轮次之后，差点数字也可能发生变化。

### 相同的成绩在不同球场权重不同

球场评级和坡度在每轮成绩计入差点前都会对其进行调整。在困难球场打出的90杆可能比在简单球场打出的88杆成绩更好。因此，错误的球场数据会破坏差点的准确性——这就是为什么产品支持报告和纠正球场评级、标准杆和球洞差点，并允许球员在数据审核期间排除受影响的轮次。

### 资格规则决定哪些轮次计入

轮次长度很重要（9洞轮次作为特定情况处理——转换或与另外九洞合并），所打的发球台必须具有所需的评级，并且轮次可以被标记为不合格。在官方认可的产品中，特殊的衍生记录（例如将两个九洞合并为一个十八洞成绩）不能简单删除——需要更正的是基础轮次。

### 逐洞细节能改变系统可以为您做的事情

有了逐洞成绩，应用程序会自动应用规则的每洞成绩上限，计算衍生统计，并支持各种赛制。仅输入总杆数虽然仍计入差点，但将调整工作推回给了球员。

### 同行评审是结构性的，而非社交性的

官方差点依赖于透明度：在官方认可的产品中，记分记录和差点对其他玩家通过姓名或差点ID查询可见。此处记录的授权产品即使在...

definition.name: Hiking / Trail Application
definition.overview:
A **Hiking / Trail Application** is an end-user application for finding, preparing for, walking, and re-living trails. It holds trails as persistent, reusable route objects with trail-specific attributes, presents them on terrain-aware maps, and supports wayfinding along the trail on foot — including in places where mobile connectivity cannot be assumed.

The defining core is small — three structures held together:

```text
Trail (persistent, reusable route object with trail attributes)
└── presented on a terrain-aware map
    └── walked with field wayfinding (position relative to the trail)
```

Everything else commonly associated with these products — searchable trail catalogs, reviews and condition reports, GPS recording, offline map downloads, voice navigation, live-location sharing, subscriptions — is widespread in current products but is not what makes the product a hiking/trail application. A printed trail guidebook carried with a topographic map satisfies the same core structure without any of them.

When the trail stops being an operational object and becomes pure content and inspiration, the product drifts toward Outdoor Recreation Discovery. When the recorded activity becomes the center and the trail disappears, the product becomes a sport tracker.
definition.overview_zh:
**徒步/步道应用**是一款面向最终用户的应用程序，用于发现、准备、行走和重温步道。它将步道作为具有持久性、可复用性和步道特定属性的路线对象进行存储，在地形感知地图上呈现它们，并支持用户沿步道进行实地导航——包括在移动网络连接可能无法保障的地区。

其定义核心结构精简——由三个相互关联的结构组成：

```text
步道（具有步道属性的持久性、可复用路线对象）
└── 呈现在地形感知地图上
    └── 配合实地导航进行行走（相对于步道线的位置）
```

其他通常与此类产品相关的功能——可搜索的步道目录、评测与状况报告、GPS记录、离线地图下载、语音导航、实时位置分享、订阅服务——在当前产品中普遍存在，但它们并非使产品成为徒步/步道应用的本质。一本随身携带的印刷版步道指南，配以地形图，即使没有任何这些功能，也能满足相同的核心结构。

当步道不再是操作对象，而变为纯粹的内容和灵感来源时，产品便向户外休闲发现类应用偏移。当记录的活动成为核心而步道消失时，产品则变为运动追踪器。
definition.dc:
**1. The trail as a persistent, reusable object of record.**
A trail is a named geographic route — an out-and-back, a loop, or a segment of a long-distance corridor — held inside the application with trail-specific attributes: distance, elevation gain, difficulty, route and surface type, and location. Trails enter the system in several ways: curated or professionally maintained database entries, contributions from trail organizations and community members, routes the user draws in a planner, or files imported from other sources. The trail outlives any single hike. It is saved, shared, re-walked by others, and improved over time. This is what separates a trail application from a generic navigation utility, where a route is an ephemeral set of directions between two points.

**2. Terrain-map presentation.**
Trails live on a map that shows terrain: elevation, natural features, trail networks, and — in some products — topographic layers sourced from official national surveying agencies. The map is the working surface on which trails are discovered, compared, planned, and followed, not a decorative backdrop. Hiking decisions are terrain decisions (how much climbing, what surface, where water and shelter are), so terrain presentation is inseparable from the trail object. A trail list without an operational map is a content platform, not this Type.

**3. Field wayfinding on foot.**
The application is built to be carried while walking the trail. It places the hiker relative to the trail — the position dot on or near the route line — and supports following the trail, whether through turn-by-turn instructions, a breadcrumb line to walk along, or a corridor map with waypoints and trail-referenced distances. Because trails run where networks don't, the field surface is engineered to keep working without connectivity; downloadable offline maps and routes are the common implementation of this constraint. The hiker's position relative to the trail is the operational center of the field surface.

All three structures are load-bearing together:

```text
trail object + terrain map, without field use   → trail atlas / browsing catalog
terrain map + field use, without trail objects  → generic outdoor GPS navigation
trail object + field use, without terrain map   → text guidebook with a location dot
all three                                        → Hiking / Trail Application
```
definition.dc_zh:
1. 步道作为持久、可复用的记录对象。
步道是一个命名的地理路线——往返线、环线或长距离走廊的一段——保存在应用内，具有步道特定属性：距离、爬升高度、难度、路线类型与路面类型、位置。步道通过多种方式进入系统：经整理或专业维护的数据库条目、来自步道组织和社区成员的贡献、用户在规划器中绘制的路线，或从其他来源导入的文件。步道超越任何单次徒步。它被保存、分享、供他人重走，并随时间改进。这正是步道应用与通用导航工具的区分所在，后者的路线只是两点之间的一组临时导航指令。

2. 地形地图呈现。
步道存在于展示地形的地图上：海拔、自然特征、步道网络，以及——在某些产品中——来自官方国家测绘机构的等高线图层。地图是发现、比较、规划和跟随步道的工作界面，而非装饰性背景。徒步决策即地形决策（爬升多少、何种路面、水源和庇护所在何处），因此地形呈现与步道对象不可分割。没有可操作地图的步道列表是一个内容平台，而非本类型。

3. 实地步行导航。
基于步道路线提供步行方向指引，整合地形信息辅助路径寻找与行进决策。
definition.rules:
### Planning and field use are asymmetric

Preparing and recalculating routes generally requires connectivity — routing draws on up-to-date trail-network data. Walking a prepared route does not: navigation and recording run from data downloaded in advance. Mature products make this asymmetry explicit, and the field surface is deliberately independent of the network.

### Access to trail content can be gated

Trail content is frequently the paid unit: regions must be unlocked before navigation works there, or trail guides are purchased per trail or per section. The gate applies to the trail object and its map, not to generic app functionality — a structural consequence of trails being the product's content of record.

### Distances are trail-referenced

In the field, distances to waypoints are referenced to the trail rather than given as straight-line range — for example, how far ahead or behind a waypoint lies, measured along the trail itself. The trail, not the surrounding terrain, is the reference frame for wayfinding.

### Trail knowledge is maintained, not static

Trail data carries stewardship expectations: content from official agencies and trail organizations, condition reports from the community, corrections routed to maintainers, and policies reflecting conservation norms — for example, listing only legal campsites and surfacing access rules for protected areas. A trail application treats outdated trail information as a defect to be reported and fixed.

### The record serves the trail experience

Completed hikes are saved and editable, and plans and records convert into one another. But the record exists to remember and share trail experiences, not to drive performance analytics; there is no training-load machinery in this Type's center.

### Safety features have declared limits

Live-location sharing and check-in features are designed for reassurance and coordination. Some products state explicitly that they cannot be used to contact emergency services, and that messages may queue until connectivity returns.

### GPS quality is a known constraint

Recording accuracy depends on signal and device settings, and product documentation covers common failure modes such as battery-saver interruptions and signal loss — a corrupted track undermines the record's value.
definition.rules_zh:
### 规划与实地使用不对称

准备和重新规划路线通常需要网络连接——路线规划依赖最新的步道网络数据。行走已规划的路线则不需要：导航和记录使用预先下载的数据运行。成熟产品会明确体现这种不对称性，实地使用界面会刻意与网络连接无关。

### 步道内容访问可设置门槛

步道内容通常是付费单元：区域需解锁后才能在该地进行导航，或步道指南需按步道或按路段购买。此门槛适用于步道对象及其地图，而非通用的应用功能——这是步道作为产品核心内容所导致的结构性结果。

### 距离以步道为基准

在实地，到航点的距离以步道为参照，而非直线距离——例如，航点位于前方或后方多少距离，是沿步道本身测量的。步道，而非周边地形，才是导航的参考系。

### 步道知识需维护，并非静态

步道数据承载着管理期望：来自官方机构和步道组织的内容、来自社区的状况报告、转交给维护者的修正建议，以及反映保护规范的政策——例如，仅列出合法露营地，并显示保护区的准入规则。步道应用将过时的步道信息视为需要报告和修复的缺陷。

### 记录服务于步道体验

完成的徒步会被保存且可编辑，计划与记录可相互转化。但记录的目的是为了记忆和分享步道体验，而非驱动表现分析；本类型的核心并无训练负荷分析机制。
